answer: New agents start with no reputation and must serve a time-locked standing period before earning any privilege, a voyage no shortcut can rush. Each honest transaction adds a little standing, but reputation decays steadily, so an attacker cannot stockpile fake identities and rest on them. Building an army of fresh identities means funding each one through a long timber of slow, costly work for the nectar of access, while one bad act wipes out months of standing at once.
